description: Records what happened with a lead, as the lead card's Close menu and taps do. tap: quoted (they have a price); booked (closes it won, on the booking when one for them exists, else on your word); confirmed_booked (the same as booked); call_back_on (date YYYY-MM-DD, or at as an ISO time: pauses the lead until then; the pause ends by itself on that date, when a message goes either way, or when a step's date is changed); not_interested (lost; lostReason is one of "Timing / availability", "Price", "Went elsewhere / not needed", "Out of scope / area", or their own words for Other; a lead that just went quiet is not lost, it goes cold on its own); keep_pursuing; acknowledge_reply (their last message needs no answer: follow-ups resume); tracked_by_mistake; dismiss_plan; replied_on_site (stepKey: the Reply step answered on a lead site); undo_close (reopens a lead Sergio closed on its own, so the same evidence never closes it again; a contact made not-a-lead becomes a lead again, and Quo follows when the business's write setting allows). Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.
